rooms.description: The Fish Tank appears after completing one bundle. Completing all Fish Tank bundles will remove the Glittering Boulder to the left of The Mines entrance. Willy will also give the player a Copper Pan that can be used to collect metal ores and other items from bodies of water. Upon completion, the broken fish tank will turn into a working Fish Tank, containing 1 Catfish, 1 Sunfish, and 1 Snail. Players can then add fish and decorations to the tank, as with any other fish tank.
